project_type: AWS CDK v2 (Python) IaC monorepo for an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore + Strands rewrite of mahalo-dock; plus a Next.js 16 static frontend, FastAPI thin-API Lambda, and tools Lambdas.
language: Python (CDK + Lambdas + agent), bash (builder script), PowerShell (operator/VDI), TypeScript/Next.js (frontend).
build_system: AWS CDK v2 Python (aws-cdk-lib>=2.251,<3) under infra-cdk/ with its own .venv; frontend is npm + Next.js 16.3.3 static export (output:'export' -> frontend/out/).
test_framework: pytest for infra-cdk (infra-cdk/requirements-dev.txt = pytest) using aws_cdk.assertions.Template per-stack assertions; vitest for frontend.
build_command: cd infra-cdk && cdk synth --all  (offline, Docker-free, credential-free; must exit 0)
test_command: cd infra-cdk && pytest tests -q   (baseline before this task: 42 passed, 1 skipped)
verification_instructions: Run from infra-cdk/ with its .venv active. (1) cdk synth MahaloBuilderStack and cdk synth --all must exit 0 with NO Docker and NO AWS credentials. (2) cdk list must report exactly 11 stacks after wiring the builder (app.py currently has 10 app stacks: 4 mocks + Gateway + MemoryIdentity + Runtime + Api + Gitea + Frontend). (3) pytest tests -q must pass (prior 42/1 plus the new builder tests). For the bash script: bash -n scripts/builder-deploy.sh (and shellcheck if available). The full live cdk deploy is an operator-only step, NOT run during implementation.
snapshot_or_generated_files: frontend/out/ is produced by `npm run build` (Next.js static export) and is uploaded by MahaloFrontendStack's BucketDeployment only when -c buildFrontend=1. Not checked in. No other generated artifacts for this task.
environment_constraints: Operator workstation is an AWS WorkSpaces VDI with NO nested virtualization = NO local Docker. All new CDK MUST synth without Docker (no DockerImageAsset, no BundlingOptions). Account <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID>, region us-east-1, SSO profile 'lava' (VDI only). The EC2 builder uses an IAM instance role (NO --profile on the builder). Never write under <FALLBACK_ROOT>. Do NOT git commit or push. New scripts go under scripts/.
contribution_requirements: Only create/modify files under the mahalo-agentcore workspace. Offline synth gate must stay green and Docker-free. frontend/AGENTS.md says read the bundled Next 16 docs under node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before touching frontend build mechanics (relevant only to confirming the `npm run build` -> out/ behavior, already verified in the design). Mirror existing per-stack test style in infra-cdk/tests/.
key_patterns: Offline-safe EC2/VPC pattern from gitea_stack.py: an `availability_zones` @property returning [f'{self.region}a'] so synth needs no AZ lookup; ec2.Vpc(max_azs=1, nat_gateways=0) with one PUBLIC subnet CREATED (not from_lookup); ec2.MachineImage.latest_amazon_linux2023(...) resolves AMI via a CloudFormation SSM-parameter at DEPLOY time (no synth-time AWS call); instance.instance.associate_public_ip_address = True; block_devices with gp3 + delete_on_termination; instance.apply_removal_policy(RemovalPolicy.DESTROY). The builder differs: pass role= at ec2.Instance construction (L2 auto-creates the CfnInstanceProfile; .role is read-only post-build), arm64 via cpu_type=ec2.AmazonLinuxCpuType.ARM_64, and ZERO ingress rules. Docker branches in runtime_stack.py/api_stack.py are flag-gated by `-c buildImage=1` / MAHALO_BUILD_IMAGE=1. frontend_stack.py BucketDeployment is gated by `-c buildFrontend=1` and uploads prebuilt frontend/out/ (no Docker). test_gitea_stack.py::test_no_docker_image_asset asserts `'DockerImage' not in str(template.to_json())` â€” reuse this.
